cohort: 605 lactating women with children aged 6 to 12 months in Ganta-Afeshum district
finding: While modern contraceptive utilization among lactating mothers in the study area was higher than national reports, a significant number of women remained at risk of pregnancy due to non-use, with mode of delivery and access to radio being significantly associated with contraceptive use.
mod_finding: Women who delivered their recent child via assisted delivery had higher odds of modern contraceptive use.
